name: Upscaler

members.name: HrcInput
members.summary: Enables the existing HRC adapter, including matching 2D geometry guidance and UDR4 lighting jitter.
members.summaryText: Enables the existing HRC adapter, including matching 2D geometry guidance and UDR4 lighting jitter.
members.remarks: Set before selecting a mode or initializing the system. Do not enable for unrelated raster or path-traced images.

members.name: UseGeometryGuidance
members.summary: Uses this scene's matching 2D Geometry buffers for edge and temporal guidance, independently of the image's lighting technique.
members.summaryText: Uses this scene's matching 2D Geometry buffers for edge and temporal guidance, independently of the image's lighting technique.
members.remarks: Set before selecting a mode or initializing the system. Leave false for images without compatible guidance.

members.name: Mode
members.summary: Gets the selected algorithm; use [`Upscaler.Select`](<xref:Upscaler#Select>) to change it. Defaults to [`UpscalerMode.None`](<xref:UpscalerMode#None>).
members.summaryText: Gets the selected algorithm; use Upscaler.Select to change it. Defaults to UpscalerMode.None.

members.name: Scale
members.summary: Gets the per-axis render scale, or 1 when the stage is disabled or no algorithm is selected.
members.summaryText: Gets the per-axis render scale, or 1 when the stage is disabled or no algorithm is selected.

members.name: Status
members.summary: Describes whether reconstruction is bypassed, guided or spatial.
members.summaryText: Describes whether reconstruction is bypassed, guided or spatial.

members.name: Dispose
members.summary: Runs when the system or scene shuts down. Release what `Initialize` created.
members.summaryText: Runs when the system or scene shuts down. Release what Initialize created.

members.name: GetOutput
members.summary: Returns the stage's current output image, or its input when processing is bypassed.
members.summaryText: Returns the stage's current output image, or its input when processing is bypassed.

members.name: Initialize
members.summary: Runs once when the scene starts. Create render targets and other resources here.
members.summaryText: Runs once when the scene starts. Create render targets and other resources here.

members.name: OnResize
members.summary: Runs after the window size changes. Recreate size-dependent render targets here.
members.summaryText: Runs after the window size changes. Recreate size-dependent render targets here.

members.name: Render
members.summary: Runs every frame to produce images other systems may read, such as lighting buffers.
members.summaryText: Runs every frame to produce images other systems may read, such as lighting buffers.

members.name: ResetHistory
members.summary: Discards reconstruction history after a camera cut, teleport or level change.
members.summaryText: Discards reconstruction history after a camera cut, teleport or level change.
members.remarks: Resets UDR4 directly. Other active algorithms are recreated to clear accumulated state.

members.name: ResolveViewSize

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: The producer's current explicit resolution, or null to use the window size.

members.returns: The scaled view size, or the original explicit resolution when reconstruction is bypassed.
members.summary: Resolves a producer's view size using the active per-axis render scale.
members.summaryText: Resolves a producer's view size using the active per-axis render scale.
members.remarks: Call when updating the view. The first unscaled resolution is retained while scaling is active.

members.name: Select

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Reconstruction algorithm, or [`UpscalerMode.None`](<xref:UpscalerMode#None>) to bypass the stage.

exceptions.description: The value is not a defined [`UpscalerMode`](<xref:UpscalerMode>).

members.summary: Selects an algorithm and releases the previous algorithm's resources.
members.summaryText: Selects an algorithm and releases the previous algorithm's resources.
members.remarks: Algorithm selection and resolution quality are independent. Change quality through [`UDRQuality.Set`](<xref:UDRQuality#Set>).

summary: Reconstructs an image at display resolution using one selected UDR algorithm.
summaryText: Reconstructs an image at display resolution using one selected UDR algorithm.
remarks: Connect `Input` to the preceding image stage and present [`Upscaler.GetOutput`](<xref:Upscaler#GetOutput>) separately. Any color-image producer can use UDR1–UDR4. Optional guidance must describe the same view as the image. The stage owns and disposes its selected algorithm.
